officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf pp30/80/142/150; printed EG-4, EG-6 and Portable Fusion Generator
scope: Power-droid bonuses and battle-destiny triggers; Fusion Generator enhancement actions and weapon draw bonuses.
method: Two droid stat boards compare ordinary, repeated-copy and canceled-text power modifiers. Cancellation is a controlled production modifier fixture.
Both Fusion Generator mirrors execute real enhancement-on and enhancement-off actions on present droids.
Both mirrors enhance actual blaster-rifle firing draws from 5 to 6; printed rifle comparison arithmetic remains separate.
Four actual battle-destiny paths compare power before/after drawing a power droid, including a higher-power side with no trigger.

Native-only cases cover ordinary deployment cost, artillery firing-user choice, original-instance departure/return, device-use limits, source cancellation, cross-turn persistence, malformed saves and canceling destiny after its required trigger.
limitations: Full engine and card certification remain unfinished. Production full-match admission stays closed; no standalone study added.
Reference boards and draw order are controlled fixtures. Ten observed outcomes do not exhaust every card interaction or mandatory trigger timing.
Repeated power-droid draws, draw selection/substitution, simultaneous required triggers and wider power-total modifier interactions still require executed conformance.
Fusion artillery bonus, deployment, transfer, departure and device-use limit branches currently have native-only checks; the GEMP comparisons here exercise rifles and enhancement on/off.
Undercover/captured/inactive exceptions, broader device permission/prevention and strategic CPU decisions for these cards remain required full-engine scope.
Browser uses test-only admission with the real nativeMatchService and SQLiteD1. These component boards do not certify full production matches.
